results.title: Call Me Queen
results.overview: The film depicts a friendship between an Irish journalist in Kenya and a Rwandan woman, who pair up to combat the AIDS crisis in the 1990s.

results.title: Where the River Begins
results.overview: Yajaira, a young but strong Embera woman, lives with her daughter Maria in a violent Bogotá neighborhood. Haunted by dreams of the jungle, she longs to return to the village she once called home. After a tragedy strikes, they have no choice but to leave. Jhon, a charismatic young gang member, joins them on their dangerous journey to the Andágueda River, driven by motives he keeps hidden.  Donde Comienza el Río is a poignant, poetic film where a perilous escape becomes a journey of healing. As the jungle reemerges through memory and dream, masks fall and reality is touched by the magic of Yajaira’s inner world.

results.title: Sally
results.overview: In this short film, gravity plays a trick on us and makes marbles rock and roll through the room, jump over the floor and even stand on their heads.

results.title: My Happy End
results.overview: All dogs chase their tails. A dog once succeeds in catching his own tail. That changes his life as he finds his best friend in it.

results.title: Quit Deacon Me Around
results.overview: A Deacon's faith is put to the test when an eccentric coroner follows him home, claiming to have trapped a demon.

results.title: The Lost City of Sanxingdui
results.overview: In the mountains of Sichuan, China, lies a mysterious ancient city that was consigned to oblivion until the chance discovery of a jade object in 1927. Since that first find, over 10,000 artefacts made of gold, jade, ivory and bronze have been unearthed, buried by the inhabitants in sacrificial pits before they left the city about 3,000 years ago. The finds include objects unlike any other: curiously shaped bronze heads and masks covered in gold foil.  The scale of the site and the number of treasures make Sanxingdui one of the most important archaeological discoveries of our time. Was this city once the capital of the ancient Shu kingdom – a kingdom whose very existence was doubted by some?  At Sanxingdui, Bronze Age treasures speak to our imagination and open a new chapter of history.

results.overview: The day Rodrigo, an 11-year-old boy, will read his first essay in front of the whole class, both he and those around him will discover the consequences of the peculiar relationship he has with his father and the hobbies they share.

results.title: Beura
results.overview: The tale of the Cailleach Bheur, the Celtic goddess of nature, storms and winter, is well known to many in the Gàidhealtachd. Said to have carved the mountains and glens with ice, and borne the islands like children on her back, the Cailleach disappeared long ago leaving us only with her song – a sad, cautionary tale. This Gaelic arts project brings music, film and verse together to reimagine Cailleach’s story for the modern era.

results.title: Why Andorra?
results.overview: With a sense of adventure and curiosity, we explore the micro-country of Andorra to understand how it has become one of the safest and most peaceful locations in the world.

results.title: Salam Shalom - The Untold Story of a Jewish Family in Pakistan
results.original_title: Salam Shalom - The Untold Story of a Jewish Family in Pakistan
results.overview: Salam Shalom follows Hazel Selzer Kahan, born in the predominantly Muslim city of Lahore to Jewish physicians who fled Nazi Germany. Now 86 and living in the U.S., Hazel revisits her hometown to preserve a legacy of refuge, survival, and cross-cultural kinship while confronting the complex layers of her identity.

results.title: Pumpkin Carving with Sam
results.overview: Sam is getting a head start on his pumpkin carving. How are you getting ready for Halloween?

results.title: Hapus
results.overview: Key is on probation at a production house. Her boss asks her to erase a mysterious figure from a video, a figure standing behind a “history expert” who is about to talk about the 1998 tragedy. She tries again and again, and fails, while strange things keep happening to her. A short horror film about the 1998 riots and the erasure of history.

results.title: The Book That Changed My Life
results.original_title: The Book That Changed My Life
results.overview: Inspired by her passion to get people reading, Her Majesty Queen Camilla joins four remarkable people to share the stories of books that shaped them.  Warm, emotional and full of hope, the film shows how reading can lift people up, open minds and even change lives in a celebration of the magic power inside every book.

results.title: Little Miss Sun Sign
results.overview: As the camera orbits him, Joey Frank struggles to convey an idea about astrology to a rotating group of guests. In 2006, in a manic episode in a matinee of Little Miss Sunshine, Joey Frank had an epiphany that he attempts to recreate by watching the film again. 14 hours of stopping and starting gets boiled and trimmed down to 101 minutes, so that Little Miss Sun Sign is the same length and size as the film from whence it came.
